transcript: Agar aap life mein low feel kar rahe ho, then this is the video for you. Hi, I am Ishan, I am 25. Pichle 5 saal se I'm building a marketing company, and today I have taken my employees for a offsite here in North Bangalore. This is the crazy pool that we have. This is the hall where everyone sits and chills and works as well. But main aapko ye kyu bata raha hu? I started at 21 with my marketing company. I had no idea that I will be here. I just know this 1 thing, that agar aapko kuch karna hai apni life mein, mehnat karo and aapko wo mil jayega. Maine mehnat kari. We used to work remotely, then we got our first office in Bangalore, then we do crazy offsites like this, and I'm just 25. People my age are still stuck in universities, completing their degrees, trying to find a job, and wondering what to do next. I was able to come here because I had a belief in my mind that main ye kar sakta hu because maine dusre logon ko karte hue dekha hai ye already. And if they can do it, so can I. And that is the winner mindset that got me to where I am today. This is the sign for you to go all in with that 1 dream that you have in your mind and create legendary success for you, for your family, and for the people that you work with.
